RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the default throttler allows the request again.

RateLimitLimit.description: Request limit for the default throttler.

ExpensiveRateLimitLimit.description: Request limit for the expensive-route throttler.

ExpensiveRateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the expensive-route window resets.
